components.provenance: V2X-06 lane: bounded cube-sphere/lat-lon surface addressing with LOD-independent location identity. It does not replace canonical selection, camera, geodesy or spatial reference-frame authority.

V2X-06 deterministic continuous spherical geography model. Continental, basin, orogenic, volcanic, impact, cryosphere and arid landform outputs are model/presentation cues, never canonical elevation or measured geology.
V2X-06 bounded deterministic drainage, river-order, lake, wetland, coastline and sediment-transport cues over generated geography. No measured flow, canonical watershed or flood-risk claim.

V2X-06 bounded hierarchical terrain materializer with deterministic same-level and mixed-LOD seam witnesses, adaptive 9/17/33 presentation resolution, entry+byte bounded cache, coast/river presentation geometry, substrate hooks and LOD reconciliation. No planet-wide full-resolution mesh is materialized.

V2X-06 Canvas2D/SVG surface presentation with bounded command budgets, explicit deterministic omission accounting, model-derived relief shading, coastline cues and river hierarchy styling. Rendering never mutates world, camera, selection or P4 history.
